Make Omarchy yours before you install it.

Try it on Windows, set it up your way, then bring your settings, files and app
data to a native Omarchy installation.

Open **Settings > Recovery > Install Omarchy** for the new walkthrough. It
checks BitLocker, helps you prepare Windows, and gives you a short import
command to run after installing Omarchy. You choose what comes along. Files
are backed up before changes, and browser profiles and sign-ins are optional.

The launcher also has a cleaner look, remembers USB devices between launches,
and follows Windows time-zone changes.

[Download Try Omarchy for Windows](https://tryomarchy.com/download)
